title: CodeHealthApproval
description: Human checkpoint decision bound to one candidate and its exact approved scope.

candidateId.description: Stable candidate identifier receiving the checkpoint decision.

decision.description: Human decision for the exact candidate scope.

approvedAction.description: Action approved, rejected, or deferred for this candidate.

approvedFiles.description: Exact repository-relative files covered by the decision.

approvedSymbols.description: Exact symbols, tests, or call sites covered by the decision.

scopeHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact candidate scope with a sha256 prefix.

rationale.description: Specific human rationale for the decision.

actor.description: Human decision-maker identity; agent identities cannot substitute for a human checkpoint.

decidedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the human checkpoint decision.

signatureRef.description: Repository-relative signature or provenance reference for the human decision.

revision.description: Revision at which the human decision was made.

relativePath.description: Safe repository-relative POSIX path without absolute paths, backslashes, parent traversal, or empty segments.
